/-
  TRAINING SPLIT of TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms. Generated from Core/Vocab/Atoms.lean by
  ontology_provenance/nrs_tools/atoms_train.py: the definitions of the atoms whose only textual
  support is a test line are omitted. Do not edit; regenerate.
-/
/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
  The bijection with the atoms of ATOMS.md: exactly one definition per atom id, named `family_name`,
  each reading one field of `World` and nothing else. Attribute accessors of an atom carry the
  atom's name plus a suffix (`dev_traffic_signal_shows`, `ru_rider_posture_on_seat`).

  Rules of this file, held by the doctor:
  - every `\`family.name\`` in ATOMS.md has exactly one `def family_name` here and vice versa;
  - no thresholds, no comparisons against constants, no temporal lookback: a threshold is a rule's
    or a derived concept's business;
  - the `rel_*` atoms may compute geometry from kinematics, because their contract says they are
    "computed from kinematics; listed because a source may supply them measured" — a measured
    value, when the source gives one, is preferred; `rel_visible` reads a measured value only.

  Every atom is three-valued: `none` is "not observed on this source".
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions

namespace TrafficSpec

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Geometry helpers for the `rel_*` atoms (exact rationals; the one square root is an integer
-- square root at micrometre resolution).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
namespace Geom
def vsub (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.sub a.1 b.1, Q.sub a.2 b.2)
def vadd (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add a.1 b.1, Q.add a.2 b.2)
def dot (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.add (Q.mul a.1 b.1) (Q.mul a.2 b.2)
/-- 2-D cross product `a × b`; positive when `b` is to the left of `a`. -/
def cross (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.sub (Q.mul a.1 b.2) (Q.mul a.2 b.1)
def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
  else
    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)
  if Q.isZero m then none
  else
    let b := (Q.div a.1 m, Q.div a.2 m)
    let n := norm b
    some (Q.div b.1 n, Q.div b.2 n)
/-- Components of `v` in the frame of heading `h` (longitudinal, lateral); lateral positive = left.
    `h` is read as a direction (`unit`), whatever its length; `v` keeps its own. -/
def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let u ← unit h
  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let ap := vsub p a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))
    norm (vsub p (vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)))
/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let n := poly.length
  if n < 3 then false
  else
    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
         !Q.isZero dy &&
         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
    crossings.length % 2 == 1
/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
  let n := poly.length
  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
  | _ =>
    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let n := poly.length
      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then a
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some a
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
      | none => some c
      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => []
  | [a] => [a]
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
    | [] => []
    | d :: ds =>
      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
  else
    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
      | none => some d
      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let es := (edges poly).toArray
  let n := es.size
  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
    if j ≤ i then false
    else
      let (a, b) := es[i]!
      let (c, d) := es[j]!
      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
    let d := vsub b a
    let w := vsub a p
    let den := cross u d
    if Q.isZero den then
      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
    else
      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []
end Geom

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def hasClass (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (c : RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
  (s.user x).bind fun u => if u.unobservedClasses.contains c then none else u.classes.map (·.contains c)

def ru_motor_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .motorVehicle
def ru_motorcycle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .motorcycle
def ru_moped (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .moped
def ru_bus (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .bus
def ru_transit_bus (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .transitBus
def ru_school_bus (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .schoolBus
def ru_taxicab (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .taxicab
def ru_tour_bus_or_limousine (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .tourBusOrLimousine
def ru_truck (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .truck
def ru_commercial_motor_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .commercialMotorVehicle
def ru_trailer_or_combination (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .trailerOrCombination
def ru_bicycle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .bicycle
def ru_electric_bicycle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .electricBicycle
def ru_electric_scooter (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .electricScooter
def ru_pedestrian (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .pedestrian
def ru_pedestrian_with_white_cane_or_guide_animal (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .pedestrianWithWhiteCaneOrGuideAnimal
def ru_child (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .child
def ru_emergency_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .emergencyVehicle
def ru_fire_apparatus (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .fireApparatus
def ru_official_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .officialVehicle
def ru_rail_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .railVehicle

def ru_subject (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := s.subject.map (· == x)
/-- Whether the road user carries one of the listed classes: true when it carries one; unknown when
    none holds and a listed class is unobserved (or the classes were not observed at all); false
    otherwise. A legal aggregate's membership is read through it, once for the classes its
    definition includes and once for those it leaves unresolved. -/
def ru_aggregate (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (members : List RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
  (s.user x).bind fun u =>
    let has : List (Option Bool) := members.map fun c =>
      if u.unobservedClasses.contains c then none else u.classes.map (·.contains c)
    if has.any (· == some true) then some true
    else if has.any (·.isNone) then none
    else some false

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Road structure and occupancy
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b

/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
    other kind is known not to be one. -/
def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind

/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
    else some false
  if k.isAbstract then
    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
  else concrete k

/-- Whether a region is of a kind (`Structure.isOfKind`); unknown for a region not in the scene. -/
def isKind (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  (s.structure? r).bind (·.isOfKind k)

/-- Whether `r'` is lane `r`'s neighbour of the same direction on its left: decided false for every
    `r'` where `r` is first from the left, unknown where neither the neighbour nor the lane's place
    is observed. -/
def st_lane_left_of (s : Scene) (r r' : RegionId) : Option Bool :=
  match st_lane_adjacency_left s r with
  | some n => some (n == r')
  | none => if st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s r == some 1 then some false else none
/-- Whether `r'` is lane `r`'s neighbour of the same direction on its right: decided false for every
    `r'` where `r` is last of the lanes in its direction. -/
def st_lane_right_of (s : Scene) (r r' : RegionId) : Option Bool :=
  match st_lane_adjacency_right s r with
  | some n => some (n == r')
  | none =>
    match st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s r, st_lane_adjacency_count s r with
    | some o, some n => if o == n then some false else none
    | _, _ => none

/-- Geometry accessors every structure atom shares: the reference point and the boundary polygon. -/
def st_region_geometry (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option (Option Vec × Option (List Vec)) :=
  (s.structure? r).map fun st => (st.position, st.boundary)
def st_region_geometry_position (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option Vec := (s.structure? r).bind (·.position)
def st_region_geometry_boundary (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option (List Vec) := (s.structure? r).bind (·.boundary)
/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
  let p ← kin_position s x
  let h ← kin_heading s x
  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
  let u ← Geom.unit h
  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]

/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
    to its reference point. -/
def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
  let p ← kin_position s x
  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
  | some poly, some fp =>
    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
  | none, fp =>
    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
    match fp with
    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))
/-- The regions present in the scene known to be of a kind (`Structure.isOfKind` true). -/
def regionsOfKind (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k == some true)).map (·.id)
/-- The regions a quantifier over a kind ranges over: those whose membership of the kind is not
    false (`Structure.isOfKind`), the known members and those that may be members. -/
def regionCandidates (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k != some false)).map (·.id)

def rel_occupies (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Bool :=

/-- Every region the road user occupies, when its occupancy was observed. -/
def rel_occupies_regions (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List RegionId) :=
  if s.occupancyObserved.contains x then some ((s.occupies.filter (·.1 == x)).map (·.2)) else none

def env_visibility (s : Scene) : Option Q := s.env.visibility
def env_civil_time (s : Scene) : Option CivilTime := s.env.civilTime

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
  | some d => some d
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))

/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let pa ← kin_position s a
  let pb ← kin_position s b
  let ha ← kin_heading s a
  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)

/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
  | none => do
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
    or overlap, never negative. -/
def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm

/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
    else
      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
      else if shared.contains none then none
      else some false
def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a

/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let u ← Geom.unit ha
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))

/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    let va ← kin_velocity s a
    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)

/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)

/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => relFrame s a b
def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero

/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero

/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)

end TrafficSpec

5	/-
6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
7	  What the formula language cannot express, each a geometric computation with no legal word in it:
8	  a heading change integrated over a window, the closest approach of two bodies under constant
9	  velocities, the structured matching of a sign's legend. One definition per `prim.*` id of the
10	  ontology, named `prim_name`, computed over the whole trace from atoms only, parameters as
11	  arguments with no default.
12	
13	  A concept (a pipeline node) is written over atoms and primitives in the formula language and
14	  expanded before evaluation; nothing else computes a manoeuvre here. `Ctx` is the trace indexed
15	  for evaluation, shared with Semantics.lean.
16	-/
17	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
18	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.RegionTable
19	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
20	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
21	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate

23	namespace TrafficSpec
24	namespace Primitives
25	open Temporal
26	
27	/-- Whether two boundaries are the same list of vertices, each coordinate compared by its
28	    numerator and denominator. -/
29	def sameBoundary : List Vec → List Vec → Bool
30	  | [], [] => true
31	  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
32	    a.1.num == b.1.num && a.1.den == b.1.den && a.2.num == b.2.num && a.2.den == b.2.den && sameBoundary as bs
33	  | _, _ => false
34	
35	theorem sameBoundary_eq : ∀ {a b : List Vec}, sameBoundary a b = true → a = b
36	  | [], [], _ => rfl
37	  | a :: as, b :: bs, h => by
38	    simp only [sameBoundary, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
39	    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := h
40	    rcases a with ⟨⟨an1, ad1, _⟩, ⟨an2, ad2, _⟩⟩
41	    rcases b with ⟨⟨bn1, bd1, _⟩, ⟨bn2, bd2, _⟩⟩
42	    simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4
43	    subst h1 h2 h3 h4
44	    rw [sameBoundary_eq h5]
45	  | [], _ :: _, h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
46	  | _ :: _, [], h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
47	
48	/-- A region's boundary with its simple-polygon flag, computed the first time it is read; the flag
49	    is the direct check of that boundary by construction. -/
50	structure SimpleEntry where
51	  id : RegionId
52	  boundary : List Vec
53	  flag : Thunk Bool
54	  ok : flag.get = Geom.simplePolygon boundary
55	
56	/-- One entry per region and distinct boundary in the trace: a map's boundaries do not change from
57	    scene to scene, so each is checked once however many scenes and calls read it. -/
58	def simpleTable (scenes : Array Scene) : List SimpleEntry :=
59	  scenes.foldl (fun acc s => s.structures.foldl (fun acc st =>
60	      match st.boundary with
61	      | none => acc
62	      | some b =>
63	        if acc.any (fun e => e.id == st.id && sameBoundary e.boundary b) then acc
64	        else ⟨st.id, b, Thunk.mk (fun _ => Geom.simplePolygon b), rfl⟩ :: acc) acc) []
65	
66	/-- The trace indexed for evaluation, with the run's reading. `aggregateOverrides` fixes the
67	    membership of a track in an aggregate to a value, for the sensitivity of a verdict to that
68	    membership; it is empty in every evaluation that judges a trace. -/
69	structure Ctx where
70	  scenes : Array Scene
71	  times : Array Q
72	  ρ : Reading
73	  aggregateOverrides : List (TrackId × String × Bool) := []
74	  /-- The simple-polygon flags of the trace's boundaries (`simpleIn`). -/
75	  simple : List SimpleEntry := simpleTable scenes
76	  /-- What a region quantifier reads of these scenes, built once and shared by every evaluation of
77	      this context (`RegionTable`). -/
78	  regions : RegionTable.Tables scenes := RegionTable.Tables.build scenes
79	
80	/-- Whether a region's boundary is a simple polygon, read from the trace's table when the region and
81	    its boundary are there, checked directly otherwise. -/
82	def simpleIn (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
83	  match c.simple.find? (fun e => e.id == r && sameBoundary e.boundary poly) with
84	  | some e => e.flag.get
85	  | none => Geom.simplePolygon poly
86	
87	/-- The table never changes the answer: a hit is the direct check of the same boundary, a miss (a
88	    region or boundary not in the table, a boundary changed since) is the direct check. -/
89	theorem simpleIn_eq (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : simpleIn c r poly = Geom.simplePolygon poly := by
90	  unfold simpleIn
91	  split
92	  · rename_i e h
93	    have hp := List.find?_some h
94	    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
95	    rw [e.ok, sameBoundary_eq hp.2]
96	  · rfl
97	
98	def Ctx.mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) : Ctx :=
99	  { scenes := τ.toArray, times := (τ.map fun s => Time.ofTimestamp s.t).toArray, ρ := ρ }
100	def Ctx.n (c : Ctx) : Nat := c.scenes.size
101	
102	/-- An argument as the dispatcher receives it: a resolved entity id (tracks, regions and devices
103	    are all `Nat`), an enumeration spelling, or a natural. -/
104	inductive DArg
105	  | v (id : Nat)
106	  | s (lit : String)
107	  | n (nat : Nat)
108	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq
109	
110	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
111	-- Lifting scene functions over the trace; positions for windows
112	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
113	def each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : Array R := c.scenes.map f
114	def eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : Array QR := c.scenes.map f
115	def timePos (c : Ctx) : Array (Option Q) := c.times.map some
116	def pathPos (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) := c.scenes.map (kin_path_length · x)
117	def positions (c : Ctx) (m : Measure) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) :=
118	  match m with | .time => timePos c | .path => pathPos c x
119	def missingPos (m : Measure) : UnknownReason :=
120	  match m with | .time => .outOfRange | .path => .absentAtom "kin_path_length"
121	
122	def bAtom (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
123	def qAtom (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
124	  match o with | some q => .ok q | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
125	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
126	-- Scene-level helpers over atoms
127	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
128	/-- Heading change (degrees, left positive) integrated over the back window of length w:
129	    prefix sums of yaw rate × interval, one window query per instant. -/
130	def yawChange (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array (Except UnknownReason Q) :=
131	  let n := c.n
132	  -- sums[i] = Σ_{k ≤ i} ω_k (t_k − t_{k−1}); a missing yaw rate contributes nothing and is tracked
133	  let sums := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Q) i =>
134	    let prev := if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!
135	    let dt := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub c.times[i]! c.times[i - 1]!
136	    acc.push (match kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x with
137	      | some ω => Q.add prev (Q.mul ω dt)
138	      | none => prev)) #[]
139	  -- lastMissing[i] = latest index ≤ i with a missing yaw rate (n when none)
140	  let lastMissing := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
141	    acc.push (if (kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x).isNone then i else (if i = 0 then n else acc[i - 1]!))) #[]
142	  let wins := Time.backWindows (timePos c) w
143	  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
144	    match wins[i]! with
145	    | none => .error .outOfRange
146	    | some win =>
147	      if !win.covered then .error (.windowTruncated "prim_heading_change")
148	      else if !win.adequate then .error (.samplingGap "prim_heading_change")
149	      else
150	        let lm := lastMissing[i]!
151	        if lm ≠ n && lm > win.j0 then .error (.absentAtom "kin_yaw_rate")
152	        else .ok (Q.sub sums[i]! sums[win.j0]!)
153	
154	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
155	-- The primitives
156	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
157	/-- minute m of the day lies in the window [start, end), wrapping past midnight when end ≤ start. -/
158	def inWindow (w : TimeWindow) (m : Nat) : Bool :=
159	  if w.startMinute < w.endMinute then w.startMinute ≤ m && m < w.endMinute
160	  else m ≥ w.startMinute || m < w.endMinute
161	
162	private def hasClassOpt (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (k : RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
163	  (s.user x).bind fun u => if u.unobservedClasses.contains k then none else u.classes.map (·.contains k)
164	
165	private def vecAtom (o : Option Vec) (name : String) : Except UnknownReason Vec :=
166	  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
167	
168	/-- Under constant velocities, the time of closest approach of the two centres and the centre
169	    distance then; `none` when the paths do not approach within `[0, horizon]`. -/
170	private def closestApproach (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Except UnknownReason (Option (Q × Q)) := do
171	  let pa ← vecAtom (kin_position s a) "kin_position"
172	  let pb ← vecAtom (kin_position s b) "kin_position"
173	  let va ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s a) "kin_velocity"
174	  let vb ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s b) "kin_velocity"
175	  let r := Geom.vsub pb pa
176	  let v := Geom.vsub vb va
177	  let vv := Geom.dot v v
178	  if Q.isZero vv then pure none
179	  else
180	    let tstar := Q.neg (Q.div (Geom.dot r v) vv)
181	    if Q.lt tstar Q.zero || Q.gt tstar horizon then pure none
182	    else pure (some (tstar, Geom.norm (Geom.vadd r (Q.mul tstar v.1, Q.mul tstar v.2))))
183	
184	/-- Signed heading change (degrees, left positive) over the back window w, integrated from the yaw
185	    rate; unknown where the window is truncated, sparsely sampled or a yaw rate is missing. -/
186	def prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array QR :=
187	  (yawChange c x w).map fun e => match e with
188	    | .error r => .error (match r with
189	        | .windowTruncated _ => .windowTruncated "prim_heading_change"
190	        | .samplingGap _ => .samplingGap "prim_heading_change"
191	        | other => other)
192	    | .ok Δ => .ok Δ
193	
194	/-- The centres approach each other within the horizon. -/
195	def prim_closest_approach_within (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array R :=
196	  each c fun s => match closestApproach s a b horizon with
197	    | .error w => R.u w
198	    | .ok o => R.ofBool o.isSome
199	
200	/-- The time of closest approach; undefined when the centres do not approach within the horizon. -/
201	def prim_closest_approach_time (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array QR :=
202	  eachQ c fun s => do
203	    match ← closestApproach s a b horizon with
204	    | some (t, _) => pure t
205	    | none => throw (.undefined "prim_closest_approach_time")
206	
207	/-- The centre distance at closest approach; undefined when the centres do not approach within the horizon. -/
208	def prim_closest_approach_distance (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array QR :=
209	  eachQ c fun s => do
210	    match ← closestApproach s a b horizon with
211	    | some (_, dist) => pure dist
212	    | none => throw (.undefined "prim_closest_approach_distance")
213	
214	/-- The legend conditions of device d hold now for road user x: a time window on a listed day (or a
215	    calendar class the scene declares), any occupancy or class condition, children present. -/
216	def prim_conditions_hold (c : Ctx) (d : DeviceId) (x : TrackId) : Array R :=
217	  each c fun s =>
218	    let conds := match dev_zone_sign_conditions s d with
219	      | some cd => some cd
220	      | none => dev_regulatory_sign_conditions s d
221	    R.bindOpt conds (.absentAtom "dev_zone_sign_conditions") fun cd =>
222	      let timeOk : R :=
223	        if cd.windows.isEmpty then R.t
224	        else R.bindOpt (env_civil_time s) (.absentAtom "env_civil_time") fun ct =>
225	          R.any (cd.windows.map fun w =>
226	            let dayOk : R := match w.calendarClass with
227	              | some cls => R.ofOption (s.assumption cls) (.assumptionMissing cls)
228	              | none => R.ofBool (w.weekdays.isEmpty || w.weekdays.contains ct.weekday)
229	            R.and dayOk (R.ofBool (inWindow w ct.minuteOfDay)))
230	      let occOk : R := match cd.minOccupancy with
231	        | none => R.t
232	        | some n => bAtom ((ru_occupant_count s x).map (· ≥ n)) "ru_occupant_count"
233	      let clsOk : R := match cd.vehicleClass with
234	        | none => R.t
235	        | some k => bAtom (hasClassOpt s x k) "ru_class"
236	      let childOk : R :=
237	        if cd.whenChildrenPresent then R.any (s.tracks.map fun y => bAtom (ru_child s y) "ru_child") else R.t
238	      R.and (R.and timeOk occOk) (R.and clsOk childOk)
239	
240	/-- The signed lateral offset of region r from road user x (m, left positive): the component,
241	    perpendicular to x's heading, of the vector from x's reference point to the nearest point of
242	    r's boundary; zero where the reference point lies inside r. Where several boundary points are
243	    equally nearest, their common component; undefined where those components differ. -/
244	def prim_region_lateral_offset (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Array QR :=
245	  eachQ c fun s => do
246	    let some p := kin_position s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_position")
247	    let some h := kin_heading s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_heading")
248	    let some poly := st_region_geometry_boundary s r | throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
249	    if Geom.inPolygon p poly then pure Q.zero
250	    else
251	      let lats ← (Geom.nearestPoints p poly).mapM fun q =>
252	        match Geom.inFrame h (Geom.vsub q p) with
253	        | some (_, lat) => pure lat
254	        | none => throw (.absentAtom "kin_heading")
255	      match lats with
256	      | [] => throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
257	      | l :: ls => if ls.all (Q.eq · l) then pure l else throw (.undefined "prim_region_lateral_offset")
258	
259	/-- The signed distance (m) from road user x's reference point to region r, along carrier l's
260	    designated direction, on the line through the reference point parallel to that direction. r is
261	    a closed set: a vertex the line only touches and an edge it runs along are points of r it meets.
262	    Zero where the reference point lies in r or on its boundary; where every point of r on the line
263	    lies ahead, the distance to the nearest of them; where every one lies behind, minus the distance
264	    to the nearest. Where the line does not meet r, the value comes from r's projection on the
265	    direction, the interval [lo, hi] of the signed distances of r's points along it: lo where lo > 0,
266	    hi where hi < 0. That value is a projection gap, not a distance along the line, so the value may
267	    jump where the line starts or stops meeting r; its sign gives the side in both cases. Undefined
268	    where the line meets r both ahead and behind, where it misses r and [lo, hi] spans or touches
269	    zero, and where
270	    r's boundary is not a simple polygon (an empty list, fewer than three vertices, zero area, or a
271	    boundary that crosses or touches itself); unknown where the position, the direction (a zero
272	    vector included) or the boundary is absent. Independent of the boundary's start vertex and
273	    orientation. The direction is normalised as `st_lane_direction` is read (`Geom.unit`, with Core's
274	    micrometre-rounded square root), and the distance is counted in lengths of that normalised
275	    vector, which lie between 1 and 1 + 2·10⁻⁶ m. The value is geometry only: it does not establish
276	    that x is on l, that r marks l's entrance, that x's whole body has crossed r, or that a crossing
277	    happened between observations, and a distance to r is read from `st_region_geometry_distance`. -/
278	def prim_region_offset_along (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (r l : RegionId) : Array QR :=
279	  eachQ c fun s => do
280	    let some p := kin_position s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_position")
281	    let some u := (st_lane_direction s l).bind Geom.unit | throw (.absentAtom "st_lane_direction")
282	    let some poly := st_region_geometry_boundary s r | throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
283	    if !simpleIn c r poly then throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
284	    let ts := Geom.lineCrossings p u poly
285	    if Geom.inPolygon p poly || Geom.onBoundary p poly then pure Q.zero
286	    else match ts with
287	      | [] =>
288	        match poly.map fun q => Q.div (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub q p) u) (Geom.dot u u) with
289	        | [] => throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
290	        | t :: rest =>
291	          if (t :: rest).all (Q.lt Q.zero ·) then pure (rest.foldl Q.min t)
292	          else if (t :: rest).all (Q.lt · Q.zero) then pure (rest.foldl Q.max t)
293	          else throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
294	      | t :: rest =>
295	        if ts.all (Q.lt Q.zero ·) then pure (rest.foldl Q.min t)
296	        else if ts.all (Q.lt · Q.zero) then pure (rest.foldl Q.max t)
297	        else throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
298	
299	/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant (`Term.distanceWhile`). -/
300	def distanceWhile (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
301	  Temporal.distanceWhileAll (pathPos c x) holds
302	
303	/-- Signed heading change (degrees, left positive) of road user x since ψ last became true
304	    (`Term.headingSince`), integrated from the yaw rate as `prim_heading_change` integrates it, with
305	    `maxStep` bounding every interval from the one ending at the start. -/
306	def headingSince (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (maxStep : Q) (ψ : Array R) : Array QR :=
307	  Accumulate.sinceRiseIntegralAll c.times (c.scenes.map (kin_yaw_rate · x)) maxStep "heading_since"
308	    (.absentAtom "kin_yaw_rate") ψ
309	
310	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
311	-- Tables and dispatch by name
312	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
313	/-- Every `prim_*` definition of this file. The doctor holds this against `primitiveIds`. -/
314	def primitiveNames : List String :=
315	  ["prim_heading_change", "prim_closest_approach_within", "prim_closest_approach_time",
316	   "prim_closest_approach_distance", "prim_conditions_hold", "prim_region_lateral_offset",
317	   "prim_region_offset_along"]
318	
319	/-- The atoms each primitive reads (Lean names of Atoms.lean); Manifest.lean turns a primitive
320	    into the atoms a source must observe. -/
321	def reads (n : String) : List String :=
322	  match n with
323	  | "prim_heading_change" => ["kin_yaw_rate"]
324	  | "prim_closest_approach_within" | "prim_closest_approach_time" | "prim_closest_approach_distance" => ["kin_position", "kin_velocity"]
325	  | "prim_conditions_hold" => ["dev_zone_sign", "dev_regulatory_sign", "env_civil_time", "ru_occupant_count", "ru_child"]
326	  | "prim_region_lateral_offset" => ["kin_position", "kin_heading", "st_region_geometry"]
327	  | "prim_region_offset_along" => ["kin_position", "st_lane_direction", "st_region_geometry"]
328	  | _ => []
329	
330	/-- The sort each entity argument of a primitive must have (`none` marks a literal or natural
331	    position). The static check holds variables to these. -/
332	def argSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
333	  let t := some EntityKind.track
334	  match name with
335	  | "prim_heading_change" => some [t]
336	  | "prim_closest_approach_within" | "prim_closest_approach_time" | "prim_closest_approach_distance" => some [t, t]
337	  | "prim_conditions_hold" => some [some EntityKind.device, t]
338	  | "prim_region_lateral_offset" => some [t, some EntityKind.region]
339	  | "prim_region_offset_along" => some [t, some EntityKind.region, some EntityKind.region]
340	  | _ => none
341	
342	private def tid (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason TrackId :=
343	  match a with | .v t => .ok t | .n n => .ok n | _ => .error (.malformed "entity")
344	
345	/-- A name no primitive carries: a concept call that no expansion replaced, or a misspelling. -/
346	private def unknownName (n : String) : UnknownReason :=
347	  if primitiveNames.contains n then .malformed s!"arity {n}" else .malformed s!"concept {n}"
348	
349	/-- Boolean primitives by name. Unlisted names and wrong arities are `malformed`. -/
350	def evalB (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason (Array R) :=
351	  match name, args, ps with
352	  | "prim_closest_approach_within", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_within c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
353	  | "prim_conditions_hold", [d, x], [] => do pure (prim_conditions_hold c (← tid d) (← tid x))
354	  | n, _, _ => .error (unknownName n)
355	
356	/-- Quantity-valued primitives by name. -/
357	def evalQ (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason (Array QR) :=
358	  match name, args, ps with
359	  | "prim_heading_change", [x], [w] => do pure (prim_heading_change c (← tid x) w)
360	  | "prim_closest_approach_time", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_time c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
361	  | "prim_closest_approach_distance", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_distance c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
362	  | "prim_region_lateral_offset", [x, r], [] => do pure (prim_region_lateral_offset c (← tid x) (← tid r))
363	  | "prim_region_offset_along", [x, r, l], [] => do pure (prim_region_offset_along c (← tid x) (← tid r) (← tid l))
364	  | n, _, _ => .error (unknownName n)
365	
366	
367	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
368	-- Lengths: a primitive returns one value per observation.
369	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
370	theorem size_each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : (each c f).size = c.n := by simp [each, Ctx.n]
371	theorem size_eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : (eachQ c f).size = c.n := by simp [eachQ, Ctx.n]
372	theorem size_prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : (prim_heading_change c x w).size = c.n := by
373	  simp [prim_heading_change, yawChange]
374	theorem size_distanceWhile (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (holds : Array R) :
375	    (distanceWhile c x holds).size = holds.size := by
376	  simp [distanceWhile, Temporal.size_distanceWhileAll]
377	theorem size_headingSince (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (g : Q) (ψ : Array R) :
378	    (headingSince c x g ψ).size = ψ.size := by
379	  simp [headingSince, Accumulate.size_sinceRiseIntegralAll]
380	
381	/-- A Boolean primitive that returns an array returns one value per observation. -/
382	theorem size_evalB (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) (a : Array R)
383	    (h : evalB name c args ps = .ok a) : a.size = c.n := by
384	  unfold evalB at h
385	  split at h <;> (try simp only [bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h) <;> (repeat' split at h) <;>
386	    first | (cases h; simp [prim_closest_approach_within, prim_conditions_hold, size_each]) | cases h
387	
388	/-- A quantity primitive that returns an array returns one value per observation. -/
389	theorem size_evalQ (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) (a : Array QR)
390	    (h : evalQ name c args ps = .ok a) : a.size = c.n := by
391	  unfold evalQ at h
392	  split at h <;> (try simp only [bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h) <;> (repeat' split at h) <;>
393	    first
394	    | (cases h; simp [prim_heading_change, yawChange, prim_closest_approach_time, prim_closest_approach_distance,
395	                      prim_region_lateral_offset, prim_region_offset_along, size_eachQ, Ctx.n])
396	    | cases h
397	
398	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
399	-- One integral, one interval convention, one unit
400	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
401	private theorem sums_get (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (g : Q) :
402	    ∀ k, k < c.n → ((List.range c.n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Q) i =>
403	      acc.push (match kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x with
404	        | some ω => Q.add (if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!) (Q.mul ω (if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub c.times[i]! c.times[i - 1]!))
405	        | none => if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!)) #[])[k]! =
406	      (Accumulate.runAt c.times (c.scenes.map (kin_yaw_rate · x)) g k).sum := by
407	  refine (Accumulate.build_get _ (fun k => (Accumulate.runAt c.times (c.scenes.map (kin_yaw_rate · x)) g k).sum) c.n ?_
408	    c.n (Nat.le_refl _)).2
409	  intro acc i hi _ hm
410	  have hr : (c.scenes.map (kin_yaw_rate · x))[i]! = kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x := by
411	    rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa [Ctx.n] using hi), Array.getElem_map, getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa [Ctx.n] using hi)]
412	  cases i with
413	  | zero => simp only [Accumulate.runAt, Accumulate.runStep, Accumulate.dt, hr, if_true, Accumulate.Run.init]; rfl
414	  | succ k =>
415	    simp only [Accumulate.runAt, Accumulate.runStep, Accumulate.dt, hr, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false,
416	      Nat.add_sub_cancel, hm k (by omega)]; rfl
417	
418	/-- T11: where the window of `prim_heading_change` starts exactly at the start of `headingSince` and
419	    both are decided, they are the same rational. -/
420	theorem headingSince_agrees_prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (g w : Q) (ψ : Array R)
421	    (i j : Nat) (hψ : ψ.size = c.n) (hi : i < c.n) (win : Time.Back)
422	    (hwin : (Time.backWindows (timePos c) w)[i]! = some win) (hj0 : win.j0 = j)
423	    (hanc : (Temporal.runStartAll "heading_since" ψ)[i]! = .ok (some j)) (a b : Q)
424	    (ha : (headingSince c x g ψ)[i]! = .ok a) (hb : (prim_heading_change c x w)[i]! = .ok b) :
425	    a = b := by
426	  have hψi : i < ψ.size := hψ ▸ hi
427	  obtain ⟨hg, -⟩ := Accumulate.decided_anchored i hψi a ha
428	  have hst : Accumulate.startAt "heading_since" ψ i = .ok (some j) :=
429	    (Accumulate.runStartAll_get _ ψ i hψi).symm.trans hanc
430	  have hj : j ≤ i := ((Accumulate.startAt_some_iff i j).mp hst).1
431	  unfold headingSince at ha
432	  rw [Accumulate.get_pos hg i hψi, hst] at ha
433	  simp only at ha
434	  split at ha
435	  · cases ha
436	  split at ha
437	  · cases ha
438	  cases ha
439	  have hs : (yawChange c x w).size = c.n := by simp [yawChange]
440	  simp only [prim_heading_change] at hb
441	  rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa [hs] using hi), Array.getElem_map] at hb
442	  simp only [yawChange, Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_range, hwin, hj0] at hb
443	  rw [sums_get c x g i hi, sums_get c x g j (by omega)] at hb
444	  cases hc : win.covered <;> cases hd : win.adequate <;> simp only [hc, hd] at hb <;> try simp at hb
445	  split at hb
446	  · simp at hb
447	  · rename_i Δ heq
448	    simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at hb
449	    subst hb
450	    split at heq
451	    · cases heq
452	    · cases heq; rfl
453	
454	end Primitives
455	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TRAINING SPLIT variant, generated by harness/tools/split.py from the full file: the lines that read the
  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
-/
/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
  What the formula language cannot express, each a geometric computation with no legal word in it:
  a heading change integrated over a window, the closest approach of two bodies under constant
  velocities, the structured matching of a sign's legend. One definition per `prim.*` id of the
  ontology, named `prim_name`, computed over the whole trace from atoms only, parameters as
  arguments with no default.

  A concept (a pipeline node) is written over atoms and primitives in the formula language and
  expanded before evaluation; nothing else computes a manoeuvre here. `Ctx` is the trace indexed
  for evaluation, shared with Semantics.lean.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.RegionTable
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Primitives
open Temporal

/-- Whether two boundaries are the same list of vertices, each coordinate compared by its
    numerator and denominator. -/
def sameBoundary : List Vec → List Vec → Bool
  | [], [] => true
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    a.1.num == b.1.num && a.1.den == b.1.den && a.2.num == b.2.num && a.2.den == b.2.den && sameBoundary as bs
  | _, _ => false

theorem sameBoundary_eq : ∀ {a b : List Vec}, sameBoundary a b = true → a = b
  | [], [], _ => rfl
  | a :: as, b :: bs, h => by
    simp only [sameBoundary, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := h
    rcases a with ⟨⟨an1, ad1, _⟩, ⟨an2, ad2, _⟩⟩
    rcases b with ⟨⟨bn1, bd1, _⟩, ⟨bn2, bd2, _⟩⟩
    simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4
    subst h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [sameBoundary_eq h5]
  | [], _ :: _, h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
  | _ :: _, [], h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h

/-- A region's boundary with its simple-polygon flag, computed the first time it is read; the flag
    is the direct check of that boundary by construction. -/
structure SimpleEntry where
  id : RegionId
  boundary : List Vec
  flag : Thunk Bool
  ok : flag.get = Geom.simplePolygon boundary

/-- One entry per region and distinct boundary in the trace: a map's boundaries do not change from
    scene to scene, so each is checked once however many scenes and calls read it. -/
def simpleTable (scenes : Array Scene) : List SimpleEntry :=
  scenes.foldl (fun acc s => s.structures.foldl (fun acc st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | none => acc
      | some b =>
        if acc.any (fun e => e.id == st.id && sameBoundary e.boundary b) then acc
        else ⟨st.id, b, Thunk.mk (fun _ => Geom.simplePolygon b), rfl⟩ :: acc) acc) []

/-- The trace indexed for evaluation, with the run's reading. `aggregateOverrides` fixes the
    membership of a track in an aggregate to a value, for the sensitivity of a verdict to that
    membership; it is empty in every evaluation that judges a trace. -/
structure Ctx where
  scenes : Array Scene
  times : Array Q
  ρ : Reading
  aggregateOverrides : List (TrackId × String × Bool) := []
  /-- The simple-polygon flags of the trace's boundaries (`simpleIn`). -/
  simple : List SimpleEntry := simpleTable scenes
  /-- What a region quantifier reads of these scenes, built once and shared by every evaluation of
      this context (`RegionTable`). -/
  regions : RegionTable.Tables scenes := RegionTable.Tables.build scenes

/-- Whether a region's boundary is a simple polygon, read from the trace's table when the region and
    its boundary are there, checked directly otherwise. -/
def simpleIn (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  match c.simple.find? (fun e => e.id == r && sameBoundary e.boundary poly) with
  | some e => e.flag.get
  | none => Geom.simplePolygon poly

/-- The table never changes the answer: a hit is the direct check of the same boundary, a miss (a
    region or boundary not in the table, a boundary changed since) is the direct check. -/
theorem simpleIn_eq (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : simpleIn c r poly = Geom.simplePolygon poly := by
  unfold simpleIn
  split
  · rename_i e h
    have hp := List.find?_some h
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
    rw [e.ok, sameBoundary_eq hp.2]
  · rfl

def Ctx.mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) : Ctx :=
  { scenes := τ.toArray, times := (τ.map fun s => Time.ofTimestamp s.t).toArray, ρ := ρ }
def Ctx.n (c : Ctx) : Nat := c.scenes.size

/-- An argument as the dispatcher receives it: a resolved entity id (tracks, regions and devices
    are all `Nat`), an enumeration spelling, or a natural. -/
inductive DArg
  | v (id : Nat)
  | s (lit : String)
  | n (nat : Nat)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lifting scene functions over the trace; positions for windows
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : Array R := c.scenes.map f
def eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : Array QR := c.scenes.map f
def timePos (c : Ctx) : Array (Option Q) := c.times.map some
def pathPos (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) := c.scenes.map (kin_path_length · x)
def positions (c : Ctx) (m : Measure) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) :=
  match m with | .time => timePos c | .path => pathPos c x
def missingPos (m : Measure) : UnknownReason :=
  match m with | .time => .outOfRange | .path => .absentAtom "kin_path_length"

def bAtom (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
def qAtom (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some q => .ok q | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Scene-level helpers over atoms
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Heading change (degrees, left positive) integrated over the back window of length w:
    prefix sums of yaw rate × interval, one window query per instant. -/
def yawChange (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array (Except UnknownReason Q) :=
  let n := c.n
  -- sums[i] = Σ_{k ≤ i} ω_k (t_k − t_{k−1}); a missing yaw rate contributes nothing and is tracked
  let sums := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Q) i =>
    let prev := if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!
    let dt := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub c.times[i]! c.times[i - 1]!
    acc.push (match kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x with
      | some ω => Q.add prev (Q.mul ω dt)
      | none => prev)) #[]
  -- lastMissing[i] = latest index ≤ i with a missing yaw rate (n when none)
  let lastMissing := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.push (if (kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x).isNone then i else (if i = 0 then n else acc[i - 1]!))) #[]
  let wins := Time.backWindows (timePos c) w
  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => .error .outOfRange
    | some win =>
      if !win.covered then .error (.windowTruncated "prim_heading_change")
      else if !win.adequate then .error (.samplingGap "prim_heading_change")
      else
        let lm := lastMissing[i]!
        if lm ≠ n && lm > win.j0 then .error (.absentAtom "kin_yaw_rate")
        else .ok (Q.sub sums[i]! sums[win.j0]!)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The primitives
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- minute m of the day lies in the window [start, end), wrapping past midnight when end ≤ start. -/
def inWindow (w : TimeWindow) (m : Nat) : Bool :=
  if w.startMinute < w.endMinute then w.startMinute ≤ m && m < w.endMinute
  else m ≥ w.startMinute || m < w.endMinute

private def hasClassOpt (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (k : RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
  (s.user x).bind fun u => if u.unobservedClasses.contains k then none else u.classes.map (·.contains k)

private def vecAtom (o : Option Vec) (name : String) : Except UnknownReason Vec :=
  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)

/-- Under constant velocities, the time of closest approach of the two centres and the centre
    distance then; `none` when the paths do not approach within `[0, horizon]`. -/
private def closestApproach (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Except UnknownReason (Option (Q × Q)) := do
  let pa ← vecAtom (kin_position s a) "kin_position"
  let pb ← vecAtom (kin_position s b) "kin_position"
  let va ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s a) "kin_velocity"
  let vb ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s b) "kin_velocity"
  let r := Geom.vsub pb pa
  let v := Geom.vsub vb va
  let vv := Geom.dot v v
  if Q.isZero vv then pure none
  else
    let tstar := Q.neg (Q.div (Geom.dot r v) vv)
    if Q.lt tstar Q.zero || Q.gt tstar horizon then pure none
    else pure (some (tstar, Geom.norm (Geom.vadd r (Q.mul tstar v.1, Q.mul tstar v.2))))

/-- Signed heading change (degrees, left positive) over the back window w, integrated from the yaw
    rate; unknown where the window is truncated, sparsely sampled or a yaw rate is missing. -/
def prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array QR :=
  (yawChange c x w).map fun e => match e with
    | .error r => .error (match r with
        | .windowTruncated _ => .windowTruncated "prim_heading_change"
        | .samplingGap _ => .samplingGap "prim_heading_change"
        | other => other)
    | .ok Δ => .ok Δ

/-- The centres approach each other within the horizon. -/
def prim_closest_approach_within (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array R :=
  each c fun s => match closestApproach s a b horizon with
    | .error w => R.u w
    | .ok o => R.ofBool o.isSome

/-- The time of closest approach; undefined when the centres do not approach within the horizon. -/
def prim_closest_approach_time (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    match ← closestApproach s a b horizon with
    | some (t, _) => pure t
    | none => throw (.undefined "prim_closest_approach_time")

/-- The centre distance at closest approach; undefined when the centres do not approach within the horizon. -/
def prim_closest_approach_distance (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    match ← closestApproach s a b horizon with
    | some (_, dist) => pure dist
    | none => throw (.undefined "prim_closest_approach_distance")

/-- The legend conditions of device d hold now for road user x: a time window on a listed day (or a
    calendar class the scene declares), any occupancy or class condition, children present. -/
def prim_conditions_hold (c : Ctx) (d : DeviceId) (x : TrackId) : Array R :=
  each c fun s =>
    let conds := match dev_zone_sign_conditions s d with
      | some cd => some cd
      | none => dev_regulatory_sign_conditions s d
    R.bindOpt conds (.absentAtom "dev_zone_sign_conditions") fun cd =>
      let timeOk : R :=
        if cd.windows.isEmpty then R.t
        else R.bindOpt (env_civil_time s) (.absentAtom "env_civil_time") fun ct =>
          R.any (cd.windows.map fun w =>
            let dayOk : R := match w.calendarClass with
              | some cls => R.ofOption (s.assumption cls) (.assumptionMissing cls)
              | none => R.ofBool (w.weekdays.isEmpty || w.weekdays.contains ct.weekday)
            R.and dayOk (R.ofBool (inWindow w ct.minuteOfDay)))
      let occOk : R := match cd.minOccupancy with
        | none => R.t
        | some n => bAtom ((ru_occupant_count s x).map (· ≥ n)) "ru_occupant_count"
      let clsOk : R := match cd.vehicleClass with
        | none => R.t
        | some k => bAtom (hasClassOpt s x k) "ru_class"
      let childOk : R :=
        if cd.whenChildrenPresent then R.any (s.tracks.map fun y => bAtom (ru_child s y) "ru_child") else R.t
      R.and (R.and timeOk occOk) (R.and clsOk childOk)

/-- The signed lateral offset of region r from road user x (m, left positive): the component,
    perpendicular to x's heading, of the vector from x's reference point to the nearest point of
    r's boundary; zero where the reference point lies inside r. Where several boundary points are
    equally nearest, their common component; undefined where those components differ. -/
def prim_region_lateral_offset (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    let some p := kin_position s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_position")
    let some h := kin_heading s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_heading")
    let some poly := st_region_geometry_boundary s r | throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
    if Geom.inPolygon p poly then pure Q.zero
    else
      let lats ← (Geom.nearestPoints p poly).mapM fun q =>
        match Geom.inFrame h (Geom.vsub q p) with
        | some (_, lat) => pure lat
        | none => throw (.absentAtom "kin_heading")
      match lats with
      | [] => throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
      | l :: ls => if ls.all (Q.eq · l) then pure l else throw (.undefined "prim_region_lateral_offset")

/-- The signed distance (m) from road user x's reference point to region r, along carrier l's
    designated direction, on the line through the reference point parallel to that direction. r is
    a closed set: a vertex the line only touches and an edge it runs along are points of r it meets.
    Zero where the reference point lies in r or on its boundary; where every point of r on the line
    lies ahead, the distance to the nearest of them; where every one lies behind, minus the distance
    to the nearest. Where the line does not meet r, the value comes from r's projection on the
    direction, the interval [lo, hi] of the signed distances of r's points along it: lo where lo > 0,
    hi where hi < 0. That value is a projection gap, not a distance along the line, so the value may
    jump where the line starts or stops meeting r; its sign gives the side in both cases. Undefined
    where the line meets r both ahead and behind, where it misses r and [lo, hi] spans or touches
    zero, and where
    r's boundary is not a simple polygon (an empty list, fewer than three vertices, zero area, or a
    boundary that crosses or touches itself); unknown where the position, the direction (a zero
    vector included) or the boundary is absent. Independent of the boundary's start vertex and
    orientation. The direction is normalised as `st_lane_direction` is read (`Geom.unit`, with Core's
    micrometre-rounded square root), and the distance is counted in lengths of that normalised
    vector, which lie between 1 and 1 + 2·10⁻⁶ m. The value is geometry only: it does not establish
    that x is on l, that r marks l's entrance, that x's whole body has crossed r, or that a crossing
    happened between observations, and a distance to r is read from `st_region_geometry_distance`. -/
def prim_region_offset_along (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (r l : RegionId) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    let some p := kin_position s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_position")
    let some u := (st_lane_direction s l).bind Geom.unit | throw (.absentAtom "st_lane_direction")
    let some poly := st_region_geometry_boundary s r | throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
    if !simpleIn c r poly then throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
    let ts := Geom.lineCrossings p u poly
    if Geom.inPolygon p poly || Geom.onBoundary p poly then pure Q.zero
    else match ts with
      | [] =>
        match poly.map fun q => Q.div (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub q p) u) (Geom.dot u u) with
        | [] => throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
        | t :: rest =>
          if (t :: rest).all (Q.lt Q.zero ·) then pure (rest.foldl Q.min t)
          else if (t :: rest).all (Q.lt · Q.zero) then pure (rest.foldl Q.max t)
          else throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
      | t :: rest =>
        if ts.all (Q.lt Q.zero ·) then pure (rest.foldl Q.min t)
        else if ts.all (Q.lt · Q.zero) then pure (rest.foldl Q.max t)
        else throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")

/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant (`Term.distanceWhile`). -/
def distanceWhile (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
  Temporal.distanceWhileAll (pathPos c x) holds

/-- Signed heading change (degrees, left positive) of road user x since ψ last became true
    (`Term.headingSince`), integrated from the yaw rate as `prim_heading_change` integrates it, with
    `maxStep` bounding every interval from the one ending at the start. -/
def headingSince (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (maxStep : Q) (ψ : Array R) : Array QR :=
  Accumulate.sinceRiseIntegralAll c.times (c.scenes.map (kin_yaw_rate · x)) maxStep "heading_since"
    (.absentAtom "kin_yaw_rate") ψ

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tables and dispatch by name
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Every `prim_*` definition of this file. The doctor holds this against `primitiveIds`. -/
def primitiveNames : List String :=
  ["prim_heading_change", "prim_closest_approach_within", "prim_closest_approach_time",
   "prim_closest_approach_distance", "prim_conditions_hold", "prim_region_lateral_offset",
   "prim_region_offset_along"]

/-- The atoms each primitive reads (Lean names of Atoms.lean); Manifest.lean turns a primitive
    into the atoms a source must observe. -/
def reads (n : String) : List String :=
  match n with
  | "prim_heading_change" => ["kin_yaw_rate"]
  | "prim_closest_approach_within" | "prim_closest_approach_time" | "prim_closest_approach_distance" => ["kin_position", "kin_velocity"]
  | "prim_conditions_hold" => ["dev_zone_sign", "dev_regulatory_sign", "env_civil_time", "ru_occupant_count", "ru_child"]
  | "prim_region_lateral_offset" => ["kin_position", "kin_heading", "st_region_geometry"]
  | "prim_region_offset_along" => ["kin_position", "st_lane_direction", "st_region_geometry"]
  | _ => []

/-- The sort each entity argument of a primitive must have (`none` marks a literal or natural
    position). The static check holds variables to these. -/
def argSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
  let t := some EntityKind.track
  match name with
  | "prim_heading_change" => some [t]
  | "prim_closest_approach_within" | "prim_closest_approach_time" | "prim_closest_approach_distance" => some [t, t]
  | "prim_conditions_hold" => some [some EntityKind.device, t]
  | "prim_region_lateral_offset" => some [t, some EntityKind.region]
  | "prim_region_offset_along" => some [t, some EntityKind.region, some EntityKind.region]
  | _ => none

private def tid (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason TrackId :=
  match a with | .v t => .ok t | .n n => .ok n | _ => .error (.malformed "entity")

/-- A name no primitive carries: a concept call that no expansion replaced, or a misspelling. -/
private def unknownName (n : String) : UnknownReason :=
  if primitiveNames.contains n then .malformed s!"arity {n}" else .malformed s!"concept {n}"

/-- Boolean primitives by name. Unlisted names and wrong arities are `malformed`. -/
def evalB (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason (Array R) :=
  match name, args, ps with
  | "prim_closest_approach_within", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_within c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
  | "prim_conditions_hold", [d, x], [] => do pure (prim_conditions_hold c (← tid d) (← tid x))
  | n, _, _ => .error (unknownName n)

/-- Quantity-valued primitives by name. -/
def evalQ (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason (Array QR) :=
  match name, args, ps with
  | "prim_heading_change", [x], [w] => do pure (prim_heading_change c (← tid x) w)
  | "prim_closest_approach_time", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_time c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
  | "prim_closest_approach_distance", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_distance c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
  | "prim_region_lateral_offset", [x, r], [] => do pure (prim_region_lateral_offset c (← tid x) (← tid r))
  | "prim_region_offset_along", [x, r, l], [] => do pure (prim_region_offset_along c (← tid x) (← tid r) (← tid l))
  | n, _, _ => .error (unknownName n)


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: a primitive returns one value per observation.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
theorem size_each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : (each c f).size = c.n := by simp [each, Ctx.n]
theorem size_eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : (eachQ c f).size = c.n := by simp [eachQ, Ctx.n]
theorem size_prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : (prim_heading_change c x w).size = c.n := by
  simp [prim_heading_change, yawChange]
theorem size_distanceWhile (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (holds : Array R) :
    (distanceWhile c x holds).size = holds.size := by
  simp [distanceWhile, Temporal.size_distanceWhileAll]
theorem size_headingSince (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (g : Q) (ψ : Array R) :
    (headingSince c x g ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  simp [headingSince, Accumulate.size_sinceRiseIntegralAll]

/-- A Boolean primitive that returns an array returns one value per observation. -/
theorem size_evalB (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) (a : Array R)
    (h : evalB name c args ps = .ok a) : a.size = c.n := by
  unfold evalB at h
  split at h <;> (try simp only [bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h) <;> (repeat' split at h) <;>
    first | (cases h; simp [prim_closest_approach_within, prim_conditions_hold, size_each]) | cases h

/-- A quantity primitive that returns an array returns one value per observation. -/
theorem size_evalQ (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) (a : Array QR)
    (h : evalQ name c args ps = .ok a) : a.size = c.n := by
  unfold evalQ at h
  split at h <;> (try simp only [bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h) <;> (repeat' split at h) <;>
    first
    | (cases h; simp [prim_heading_change, yawChange, prim_closest_approach_time, prim_closest_approach_distance,
                      prim_region_lateral_offset, prim_region_offset_along, size_eachQ, Ctx.n])
    | cases h

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- One integral, one interval convention, one unit
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private theorem sums_get (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (g : Q) :
    ∀ k, k < c.n → ((List.range c.n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Q) i =>
      acc.push (match kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x with
        | some ω => Q.add (if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!) (Q.mul ω (if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub c.times[i]! c.times[i - 1]!))
        | none => if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!)) #[])[k]! =
      (Accumulate.runAt c.times (c.scenes.map (kin_yaw_rate · x)) g k).sum := by
  refine (Accumulate.build_get _ (fun k => (Accumulate.runAt c.times (c.scenes.map (kin_yaw_rate · x)) g k).sum) c.n ?_
    c.n (Nat.le_refl _)).2
  intro acc i hi _ hm
  have hr : (c.scenes.map (kin_yaw_rate · x))[i]! = kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x := by
    rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa [Ctx.n] using hi), Array.getElem_map, getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa [Ctx.n] using hi)]
  cases i with
  | zero => simp only [Accumulate.runAt, Accumulate.runStep, Accumulate.dt, hr, if_true, Accumulate.Run.init]; rfl
  | succ k =>
    simp only [Accumulate.runAt, Accumulate.runStep, Accumulate.dt, hr, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel, hm k (by omega)]; rfl

/-- T11: where the window of `prim_heading_change` starts exactly at the start of `headingSince` and
    both are decided, they are the same rational. -/
theorem headingSince_agrees_prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (g w : Q) (ψ : Array R)
    (i j : Nat) (hψ : ψ.size = c.n) (hi : i < c.n) (win : Time.Back)
    (hwin : (Time.backWindows (timePos c) w)[i]! = some win) (hj0 : win.j0 = j)
    (hanc : (Temporal.runStartAll "heading_since" ψ)[i]! = .ok (some j)) (a b : Q)
    (ha : (headingSince c x g ψ)[i]! = .ok a) (hb : (prim_heading_change c x w)[i]! = .ok b) :
    a = b := by
  have hψi : i < ψ.size := hψ ▸ hi
  obtain ⟨hg, -⟩ := Accumulate.decided_anchored i hψi a ha
  have hst : Accumulate.startAt "heading_since" ψ i = .ok (some j) :=
    (Accumulate.runStartAll_get _ ψ i hψi).symm.trans hanc
  have hj : j ≤ i := ((Accumulate.startAt_some_iff i j).mp hst).1
  unfold headingSince at ha
  rw [Accumulate.get_pos hg i hψi, hst] at ha
  simp only at ha
  split at ha
  · cases ha
  split at ha
  · cases ha
  cases ha
  have hs : (yawChange c x w).size = c.n := by simp [yawChange]
  simp only [prim_heading_change] at hb
  rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa [hs] using hi), Array.getElem_map] at hb
  simp only [yawChange, Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_range, hwin, hj0] at hb
  rw [sums_get c x g i hi, sums_get c x g j (by omega)] at hb
  cases hc : win.covered <;> cases hd : win.adequate <;> simp only [hc, hd] at hb <;> try simp at hb
  split at hb
  · simp at hb
  · rename_i Δ heq
    simp only [Except.ok.injEq] at hb
    subst hb
    split at heq
    · cases heq
    · cases heq; rfl

end Primitives
end TrafficSpec

13	  threshold in a rule and the same threshold in a label cannot round differently.
14	-/
15	namespace TrafficSpec
